rationale: The plan matches the reference on method: limma-voom with a fixed-effects condition design and eBayes, explicitly chosen for the 60-vs-60 population cohort, with a Wilcoxon concordance check as a stated control rather than a substitute. Effect size is handled inside the test via TREAT at two stated thresholds with logFC CIs beside every p-value, BH at 0.05, and a p-value histogram inspected first; the absence of apeglm shrinkage is stated and justified. Enrichment uses camera plus fgsea on the moderated t, hallmark with version, tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window, seed and unmapped share, all explicit. QC is thorough (library sizes, blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap, outlier policy, hidden-structure reporting) but omits the sex check against XIST/Y-linked genes that the reference expects; the design formula is described rather than written literally as ~condition. The report step names every required field including sessionInfo, thresholds, n_tested/n_de and design caveats.
